messages:
becky: dropped a new Figma file with an annotated-diff flow and export variants: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi (annotated-diff, export-modal, mobile-gesture)
tom: looking good. three quick things: 1) export modal copy is vague about what's included in CSV vs JSON, 2) annotations need a compact view for high-diff runs, 3) mobile swipe to archive diffs might conflict with browser gestures.
yasmin: on copy: suggest explicit labels: 'Export diffs (CSV  rows, compact annotations)' and 'Export run (JSON  full payload)'. maybe show estimated file size for large runs.
eric: accessibility: annotation icons don't have accessible names in the compact list. screen reader users hear "button" repeatedly. also the compact annotations shrink text below recommended 14px. we should keep 14px minimum for readability.
design-bot: automated a11y scan: missing aria-labels on annotation toggle, contrast issue on ghost divider, no keyboard shortcut listed for export dialog. See /reports/scan-1850012345.pdf
yasmin: for compact annotations proposal: inline collapsed badge like "3 notes" that expands inline; add visually-hidden text: "3 annotations for this diff". this avoids long walls of text.
tom: about mobile gestures: instead of swipe-to-archive use long-press menu on mobile to avoid accidental swipes and keep desktop swipe for power users. maybe add a small setting "Enable mobile swipe" in preferences.
eric: dev note: export backend needs to include prompt-set metadata for audit logs. also add `export_reason` optional field for compliance. if provided, it should be stored with the export event.
ux-research-bot: recent interview note: users expect "annotate" to be lightweight. one participant asked for an 'export with annotations' toggle instead of separate steps. they also liked being able to bulk-tag diffs before export.
yasmin: copy nit for approval flows inside annotated diffs: current CTA 'Approve change' might be confusing because it approves the prompt set not the single diff. propose 'Approve prompt set' + small helper text 'Records which diffs were present in this run.'
becky: agree. also propose a small inline badge when approving from a diff: "Approved via diff view" so audit logs show context.
eric: keyboard: add `A` to open export dialog when focus is on the run header, `M` to open mobile gesture preferences. document in keyboard help.
design-bot: checklist updated on ticket UI-4331: add aria-labels, enforce 14px min, clarify export copy, add export_reason.
becky: action items: yasmin update Figma copy + compact annotation frames (#UX-4332), eric add export_reason backend + audit tag (#FE-740), tom prototype long-press menu and pref toggle (#UX-4333), becky coordinate QA.
yasmin: added comments in Figma and a WCAG contrast snapshot. left a suggestion for the annotation badge micro-interaction.
eric: will also add a small schema change: export event -> { user_id, run_id, export_format, include_annotations, export_reason }. pinging security for retention guidance.
becky: QA note: when exporting >50k rows make export async with email link to download rather than blocking UI. add small toast: 'Export queued  link will be emailed when ready.'
tom: prototype note: avoid relying on swipe-only affordances; show affordance icons so users discover long-press.
design-bot: added keyboard shortcut docs task and accessibility checklist to tickets.
ux-research-bot: follow-up: schedule 3 usability sessions for the compact-annotations flow next week.
becky: thanks team  I'll file the tickets and move cards into the sprint ready column. feel free to DM if you want to pair on the mobile prototype. :thumbsup:
